title: PRD Addendum v5 — D41 Post-Launch Patch Wave: Zero-Value Percents, Explicit Field Labels, Move-Path Validation Parity, Invalid-Row Render Recovery and Broker Detail (D41)

sections.heading: Change Record
sections.body: markdown: addendum v5.0 extends addendum v4 (which extends addendum v3, which extends addendum v2, which extends addendum v1, which extends PRD_DK_Bond_Tracker_v2) after owner decision D41 (CONFIRMED, 2026-11-01) — the post-launch patch wave covering form allowances, explicit date labels, the broker field, the tenure guard and invalid-row recovery. D41 embeds its own smoke/MCP evidence in the brainstorm WHY: smoke POST /watch 0.00 -> 400 (zero-value coupon rejected), unlabeled move dates (owner screenshot), a tenure-0 row inserted through the move path with a 302 redirect (MCP row id=2, start 2026-11-14, end 2026-11-30, tenure 0) that then produced 500s on four surfaces (/, /portfolio, payouts, /print — ERR-health-compute / ERR-query-counts / ERR-print-statement), and the broker provenance requirement for bond purchases. Scope of this addendum is exactly the D41 patch wave. It supersedes nothing structurally: the v4 FRs (FR-50..FR-61) stay intact and unaltered, no earlier requirement is edited or deleted, and this document only adds FR-62 onward — each new FR citing D41 — so the FR ranges of PRD_DK_Bond_Tracker_v2 and addenda v1 through v4 remain unchanged.

sections.heading: Zero-Value Coupon and Est. Yield (D41)
sections.body: The Coupon and Est. Yield fields accept 00.00 as a valid value on every entry surface — candidate add on the Watchlist, Move to Portfolio and Add Position (D41: the live smoke POST /watch 0.00 was rejected with 400, which the owner overruled). A zero coupon or zero expected yield is a legitimate offline observation and is stored and displayed unchanged. The allowance is exact, not a loosening: empty values, garbage (anything non-numeric) and negative values are still rejected with a named validation error and no write, on all three paths (D41).

sections.heading: Explicit Field Labels (D41)
sections.body: Both the Move to Portfolio form and the Add Position form SHALL carry explicit field labels — the exact strings 'Purchase date (start date)', 'End date' and 'Credit day — when the amount is credited each month' — rendered verbatim and identically on the two forms (D41: owner screenshot of unlabeled move dates). The labels describe the same inputs the design already defines: the start date, the end date, and the credit day from 1 to 31 that drives day-wise danger evaluation (FR-54). Relabeling is display-only: no field meaning, bound or engine value changes with it (D39 engine-unchanged clause preserved).

sections.heading: Move-Path Insert Validation Parity (D41)
sections.body: The Move to Portfolio insert path runs the same validation as Add Position before anything is written: dates parseable with end after start, computed tenure of at least 1 whole month, credit day an integer in 1..31, amount and percent fields valid (D41). Any violation is rejected with HTTP 400 and a named error naming the offending field — zero rows written, no partial writes, no success-shaped redirect. This is the root-cause guard of the D41 evidence: the move path previously missed the tenure check, let a tenure-0 row through with a 302 insert, and that row 500'd on four surfaces afterwards (D41).

sections.heading: Invalid-Row Render Recovery (D41)
sections.body: A stored row with bad data never takes a page down with it (D41): Dashboard (/), Portfolio (/portfolio), the payouts grid and /print render the offending row as an 'Invalid' chip carrying a Remove action, render every other row normally, and return HTTP 200 — the ERR-health-compute, ERR-query-counts and ERR-print-statement 500s are eliminated at render time by isolating the failure to its row. The Remove action deletes exactly that row after a server-side re-validation of the id (existence and row type) — the client never triggers a blind delete (D41).

sections.heading: Broker Detail Field (D41)
sections.body: A broker detail field is added for bond-purchase provenance (D41): a new nullable TEXT column on bonds, an input on the candidate-add form, the Move to Portfolio form and the Add Position form, a Broker column on the Watchlist, and display of the stored value in the Portfolio holdings detail drawer — five surfaces plus the schema. The field is free text captured offline: it is never populated by a broker integration or any network lookup (D33 offline rule preserved), it round-trips unchanged from candidate to holding on a move, and an absent broker renders blank rather than as a placeholder string.

sections.heading: Default Data
sections.body: A new installation starts empty — zero positions, zero candidates, zero payments, nothing seeded (FR-61) — and the broker column ships NULL on every fresh row until the user fills it; the patch wave seeds no data of any kind (D41 adds no seeding path).

sections.heading: Out of Scope
sections.body: The D41 patch wave changes no scope boundary: no live market data, no rating or price feeds, no broker integrations — the broker detail field is manual offline text (D33), not a connection to a broker (D41). Themes, screen structure, status model and empty default data stand as shipped in v4 (D38, D39, D40). No cloud, no accounts, no server; email remains the only outbound network use and only when the user configures their own SMTP. Android packaging and mobile apps remain out (D27). The acceptance holds: Phase-4 P&L acceptance only (L2 pending owner confirmation).

prd_items.statement: The product SHALL accept 00.00 as a valid value for the Coupon and Est. Yield fields on every entry surface — candidate add, Move to Portfolio and Add Position — and SHALL store and display it unchanged as zero, while continuing to reject empty, garbage (non-numeric) and negative values with a named validation error and no write (D41).

The Move to Portfolio form and the Add Position form SHALL each render the exact field labels 'Purchase date (start date)', 'End date' and 'Credit day — when the amount is credited each month', the same three strings verbatim on both forms, with no change to any field's meaning, bound or engine value (D41).

The Move to Portfolio insert path SHALL run the same validation as Add Position before writing — parseable dates with end after start, computed tenure of at least 1 whole month, credit day an integer in 1..31, valid amount and percent fields — and SHALL reject any violation with HTTP 400 and a named error naming the offending field, writing zero rows (no partial writes, no success-shaped redirect) (D41).

Every surface that renders rows — Dashboard (/), Portfolio (/portfolio), the payouts grid and /print — SHALL return HTTP 200 when any single stored row has bad data, while all other rows render normally; every surface that renders rows shows the Invalid chip (holdings, payouts, print marker), the dashboard exposes the bad-row count/flag as an aggregate note (no row list there), and the Remove action appears on Holdings rows and Payouts rows (single server route revalidating a holding); the Remove action SHALL delete exactly that row only after server-side re-validation of the id, so a bad row can never 500 a page (D41).

The product SHALL add a broker detail field as a nullable TEXT column on bonds, SHALL capture it on the candidate-add, Move to Portfolio and Add Position forms, SHALL render a Broker column on the Watchlist and SHALL display the stored value in the Portfolio holdings detail drawer, with the value round-tripping unchanged from candidate to holding on a move and an absent broker rendering blank (D41).
